services.name: Long Term Rentals
services.desc: Before any new Short Term Rental registration or renewal is submitted, the owner must insure that the HOA allows short term rentals at that permitted address. There will be NO refunds issued for any registration or renewal that is rejected by the HOA. The Township of Vernon has contracted with Host Compliance/Granicus, a firm that specializes in finding operators that advertise short term stays on various hotel reservation websites. The firm gathers publicly available detailed rental and location data from many hotel reservation websites on the internet, then synthesizes the information and matches it to the owner of the property using global positioning longitude and latitude coordinates
